title: Developer Portfolio
shortDescription: A responsive React portfolio combining interactive frontend design, structured project content, and an AI-powered assistant.
overview: A personal developer portfolio built with React and TypeScript to present projects, technical skills, experience, and education through a polished and responsive single-page interface. The application combines component-based frontend architecture, custom interactive effects, structured project content, and a serverless AI assistant.
problem: Create a portfolio that presents technical experience clearly while remaining maintainable as new projects are added, without relying on a CMS or unnecessarily complex backend. The site also needed to provide an engaging experience across desktop and mobile while keeping API credentials and AI functionality secure.
solution: I built the portfolio as a React and TypeScript single-page application using reusable components and structured JSON project metadata discovered automatically through Vite. Custom CSS and the Canvas API provide responsive visual effects and theming, while a Netlify Function securely integrates the OpenAI Responses API for a portfolio-specific AI assistant. The same project metadata is shared between the visible Projects UI and the assistant's context to avoid duplicating content.
outcome: The finished portfolio provides a responsive and maintainable platform for showcasing my work, with project content that can be extended largely through configuration rather than frontend changes. It also demonstrates practical frontend architecture, accessibility-conscious interaction design, serverless integration, and secure use of an external AI API.
highlights: Built a responsive single-page application using React, TypeScript, Vite, and component-specific CSS
Designed a data-driven project system where structured JSON and images are automatically discovered and rendered by the application
Reused project metadata across both the Projects UI and AI assistant to maintain a shared source of truth
Integrated the OpenAI Responses API through a Netlify Function with server-side credentials, request validation, rate limiting, and error handling
Built a custom Canvas-based particle system with pointer interaction, theme-aware rendering, responsive behaviour, and reduced-motion support
Created an interactive AI mascot whose visual states respond to assistant activity such as idle, thinking, speaking, and error states
